summary: VersaBank filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing the rehiring of Moe Danis, CFA, to its Structured Receivable Program team to support business development for its Real-Time SRP. The filing does not involve any M&A, corporate action, or special situation; it is a routine update on a personnel addition. No deal terms, shareholder vote, or strategic review are mentioned. The registrant remains an ordinary issuer. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, it maps to a non-material current report. No special-situation event is present.
